author_name: สีดา อริศ
text:
Boglàrka Tankò-Cohen 

I’m working, so I haven’t really had the chance to take a course yet, which I actually regret a bit because it’s something I really want to do. I did buy a Hebrew textbook though.  The difficult part for me is pronunciation, and also remembering words because each word changes with gender and tense, which gets very confusing.

Thank you so much for your advice. Do you have any Hebrew songs or movies you would recommend with subtitles in other languages? I’ve been trying to find Hebrew movies on Netflix, but it’s really hard to find ones with either English or Thai subtitles.
